_evidence: Inputs of the two calls made by 0x005117d3 that its own globals do not reach. (1) 0x511053: 'test byte [0x66fe38],0xff; je' gates the group/segment refresh 0x441a4f (layouts ring_008943a0+records_008943a0+segw_00441e25+groups_00868556+w1a_008943a0+segbits_00441e25 vary what it reads), so the byte is zero in half the cases. (2) 0x43ba68: for each driver esi 0..21 'test byte [esi+0x7c2a48],0xff; js' skips drivers with bit 7 set (bytes mix bit 7 set/clear), otherwise for 17 circuits x 4 slots stores the bytes [0x7adad4..0x7adad7] through 0x51f82c (cl = any byte, a plain store into the driver/circuit record of 0x52a260) and copies 0x38 bytes from 0x7adad8 (slots 0/2) or 0x7adb10 (slots 1/3) to the record returned by 0x51f837 - so those 4 + 0x70 bytes are random. All are plain data (no index/pointer use), so any value is valid; codes_0043ba12 keeps the 'I' code bytes of the records.
